kind.description: Use stocks for named stock comparisons, industry_peers for a stock versus its own registered industry peers, or previous to keep the previous comparison set.

stock_mentions.description: Exact A-share company names or codes in the current message. Copy every explicitly asked-for stock. With industry_peers, supply only the anchor if named. With previous, pass [].

subject_source.description: Use context if the user refers to a stock or comparison set from this conversation. Use message if the user names the entire set or the industry anchor.

trading_days.description: Explicit trading-day count (5, 10, 20, 60). Pass 0 when the user omits it, or -1 for explicit unsupported time ranges.

advice.description: Use declined only if the user separately asked for investment advice alongside this historical comparison.
